chunks: Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from al-Qāsim ibn Yaḥyā, from his grandfather al-Ḥasan ibn Rāshid, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Istinjāʾ with cold water cuts off hemorrhoids.

key_terms.الِاسْتِنْجَاءُ: cleansing the private parts after relieving oneself
key_terms.بِالْمَاءِ: with water, as the means of purification

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about using cold water for istinjāʾ?
ai.summary: This hadith states that cleansing oneself after relieving oneself with cold water is beneficial against hemorrhoids. It reflects an etiquette of taharah (ritual purity) together with a practical bodily benefit mentioned by Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام.
